name: (02) Thaumaturgy (Path of Conjuring) — 1 Basic — Summon the Simple Form

system.description:
A few words and a mental image draw a chunk of raw matter out of nothing: a metal rod, a wooden stake, a rock or a lump of coal, crude and unadorned.

Conjuring an object takes a full turn and produces a single homogeneous inanimate material, with no living or undead creatures and no mixed substances. At the start of every new turn you wish to keep the item, you must spend a Mental Trait, or it vanishes instantly. Record your current Mental Traits when you create it, in case it is later dispelled with Reverse Conjuration. Retest with Occult.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
